title: Ticker — Overview
description: Long-range view. Reads rollups_daily by default and raw observations on demand; the Resolution variable picks the table.

list.name: res
list.label: Resolution
list.description: daily reads rollups_daily; raw reads observations. Raw over a long window is a lot of points — that is what the rollups are for.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT day) AS "Days" FROM rollups_daily
targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT day) AS "Days" FROM rollups_daily

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Sources" FROM sources WHERE enabled = 1

panels.title: Heart rate ($res)
panels.description: Daily average with the min/max band, or raw samples. A raw sample is a one-element aggregate, so avg = min = max there.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT time, bpm_avg, bpm_min, bpm_max FROM (
  SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', o.ts) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS time,
         o.value AS bpm_avg, o.value AS bpm_min, o.value AS bpm_max
  FROM observations o JOIN metrics m ON m.id = o.metric_id
  WHERE '$res' = 'raw'
    AND m.name = 'heart_rate_bpm'
    AND o.ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') || '+00:00'
    AND o.ts <  strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to   / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') || '+00:00'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', r.day || 'T12:00:00Z') AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS time,
         r.avg_value, r.min_value, r.max_value
  FROM rollups_daily r JOIN metrics m ON m.id = r.metric_id
  WHERE '$res' = 'daily'
    AND m.name = 'heart_rate_bpm'
    AND r.day >= strftime('%Y-%m-%d', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch')
    AND r.day <= strftime('%Y-%m-%d', $__to   / 1000.0, 'unixepoch')
)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: HRV (RMSSD), daily average
panels.description: Derived from RR intervals in the ingest pipeline — no source sends this directly.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', r.day || 'T12:00:00Z') AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS time,
       r.avg_value AS rmssd
FROM rollups_daily r JOIN metrics m ON m.id = r.metric_id
WHERE m.name = 'hrv_rmssd_ms'
  AND r.day >= strftime('%Y-%m-%d', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch')
  AND r.day <= strftime('%Y-%m-%d', $__to   / 1000.0, 'unixepoch')
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Samples per day
panels.description: How much data each day actually holds — a quick way to spot a strap that stopped reporting.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', r.day || 'T12:00:00Z') AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS time,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.name = 'heart_rate_bpm' THEN r.n ELSE 0 END) AS heart_rate,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.name = 'rr_interval_ms' THEN r.n ELSE 0 END) AS rr_intervals
FROM rollups_daily r JOIN metrics m ON m.id = r.metric_id
WHERE r.day >= strftime('%Y-%m-%d', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch')
  AND r.day <= strftime('%Y-%m-%d', $__to   / 1000.0, 'unixepoch')
GROUP BY r.day
ORDER BY time

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT s.id                     AS "#",
       s.start_ts               AS "Started",
       s.end_ts                 AS "Ended",
       COALESCE(s.label, '')    AS "Label",
       s.kind                   AS "Kind",
       src.display_name         AS "Source",
       COALESCE(d.name, '')     AS "Device",
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM observations o
         JOIN metrics m ON m.id = o.metric_id
        WHERE o.session_id = s.id AND m.name = 'heart_rate_bpm') AS "Samples",
       (SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.value), 1) FROM observations o
         JOIN metrics m ON m.id = o.metric_id
        WHERE o.session_id = s.id AND m.name = 'heart_rate_bpm') AS "Avg bpm"
FROM sessions s
JOIN sources src ON src.id = s.source_id
LEFT JOIN devices d ON d.id = s.device_id
WHERE s.start_ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') || '+00:00'
  AND (s.end_ts IS NULL
       OR s.end_ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') || '+00:00')
ORDER BY s.start_ts DESC
